# Generated files: testbed

Everything in this folder is written by `npm run pack:generate -- testbed` from `pack.json`, `PROVENANCE.json` and `source/`.
Do not edit it by hand: edit the sources and regenerate. `npm test` fails when these files are stale.

- `data/scenarios/opening.json`
- `data/scenarios/summer_front.json`
- `data/strings/en.json`
- `data/world.json`
